finding.title: Array Index Out of Bounds
finding.assumptions: The 'max' variable is derived from the input array 'arr'. If 'arr' contains negative numbers, 'max' could be negative, leading to a negative size for the 'malloc' calls.

finding.title: Integer Overflow
finding.assumptions: If 'max' is a large positive number, adding 1 to it could cause an integer overflow, resulting in an undersized memory allocation.

finding.title: Use After Free
finding.assumptions: If 'arr' contains indices out of the range of the 'count' array, accessing 'count[arr[i]]' would lead to undefined behavior, potentially causing a use after free if 'count' is freed before this access.

finding.title: Use After Free
finding.assumptions: Similar to F3, if 'arr' contains indices out of the range of the 'count' array, accessing 'output[count[arr[i]] - 1]' would lead to undefined behavior, potentially causing a use after free if 'output' is freed before this access.
